mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Remark as secRemark, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Type as secType, mn.* from Sec_Selection_Record_Multiple mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id where mn.id=#{id}

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Remark as secRemark, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Type as secType, mn.* from Sec_Selection_Record_Multiple mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id where mn.id=#{id}
select * from Sec_Selection_Record_Multiple where state=7 and sec_id=#{secId} order by Create_Time desc limit 1
